DDUPS2580N.text: DDUPS2580N — Demand Duo single Grundfos UPS 25-80 N circulation pump (brass-body N code, not Nat Gas). Moves tank water through the HD/continuous-flow heaters and back on DD systems that use this pump size.

DDUPS32100N.text: DDUPS32100N — Demand Duo single Grundfos UPS 32-100 N circulation pump (brass-body N code, not Nat Gas). Larger head/port size for DD packs that specify the 32-100 pump.

DD1TSTAT.text: DD1TSTAT — Demand Duo tank thermostat / pump controller for DD1 (one heater + one pump). Watches tank temperature and runs the pump so water circulates through the heater and back to the tank when the tank cools.

DD234TSTAT.text: DD234TSTAT — Demand Duo tank thermostat / pump controller for DD2–DD4 style packs (one or two pumps). Turns pumps on when tank temperature drops below set point so heaters can recover the storage tank.

DD56TSTAT.text: DD56TSTAT — Demand Duo tank thermostat / pump controller suited to DD5 and DD6 cascading packs. Same job as the smaller DD*TSTAT controllers: call pumps from tank temperature to keep stored water hot.

DDUVC1200.text: DDUVC1200 — Demand Duo UV sterilisation unit (1200 class) for circulating warm-water loops. Optional legionella control on warm-water / WWV systems — pair with storage + UV in flow and return as the PL note requires.

DDUVC1700.text: DDUVC1700 — Demand Duo UV sterilisation unit (1700 class) for larger circulating warm-water loops. Optional UV disinfection on warm-water systems; install with the warm-water valve / storage layout the PL calls up.
